ideas.title: The Depths of Minnesota's Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: An investigation into the alleged $90M Somali fraud connected to Minnesota Medicaid and its ties to Nairobi real estate.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
What are the implications for Minnesota's Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: This story would delve into the specifics of the alleged fraud, following the money trail and exploring the connections between Minnesota's Medicaid program and international real estate.

ideas.title: The Rise of Pandemic Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: An examination of the growing trend of pandemic fraud in Minnesota, including the 41-year prison term recently imposed.
questions: What is the scope of pandemic fraud in Minnesota?
How are these cases being investigated and prosecuted?
What are the implications for public health and safety?
ideas.insight: This story would analyze data on pandemic fraud cases in Minnesota, exploring trends and patterns in the data to understand the scope of the issue.
